stories.title: Two Flintshire councillors slam running of Ewloe roundabout roadworks
stories.summary: Two Flintshire councillors have criticised the running of the active travel works at the Ewloe and St David’s roundabouts. Cllr Linda Thomas, the Labour ward councillor for Hawarden: Ewloe, said in a Facebook reply on Thursday evening that the situation was “unacceptable”. stories.title: Flintshire Council signs off Green Lane East reversal as 20mph rollback continues
stories.summary: A 515-metre stretch of Green Lane East in Sealand will return to a 30mph speed limit from 18 June, becoming the latest Flintshire road to be reversed from the default 20mph introduced across Wales in September 2023. stories.title: Deeside Northern Gateway: seven-unit scheme approved with developer forecasting up to 600 jobs
stories.summary: Plans for seven 24-hour warehouses on 27 acres of cleared land between Amazon and the new ICTUK paper mill at Deeside’s Airfields site have been approved by Flintshire County Council. Developer Marshall Commercial Development Projects forecasts the £70 million scheme will create up to 600 jobs once running, plus 300 construction jobs during the build.
